description: Funnel WebSocket fix: the client no longer logs out when the WS upgrade is blocked by a proxy (only an explicit server auth_error returns to login), with HTTP op fallback + SSE push fallback + quiet WS retry in the background, so the console stays usable over the funnel even when /ws never connects.
features: No logout on transport failure: WS upgrade blocked (proxy/funnel) keeps the page on HTTP+SSE fallback with quiet background WS retry.
Explicit server auth_error frame before WS close(4401) so the client logs out only on a truly refused token.
HTTP op fallback (chat_answer/cancel/active/frames) + SSE push fallback (/api/events) when the socket is down.
Version synced to 0.17.2 in server APP_VERSION, pyproject.toml and updates.json.
